Eight Nights

Eight impossible nights, made with Kling 4.0 in 4K 10-bit HDR.

I built each world in Midjourney, upscaled it to 8K with Kling Image 4.0, then animated the 8K frames straight in Kling 4.0 at 4K HDR, five seconds each. Cut together with my own track.

Starting from 8K keeps every snowflake, jellyfish tentacle and window light intact. In HDR, the deepest shadows and the brightest glows sit side by side. No color grading — straight out of Kling.

X doesn't support HDR, so this is an SDR version. The HDR version is in the thread.
